title: Number display on timer widget mis-aligned to the top instead of centred
line: The Timer widget on the desktop now shows its digits vertically centred instead of stuck at the top.
explanation: TimerEdit is a Row of SVG digits whose size is limited by the widget's width; it was placed directly in the ColumnLayout with fillHeight, so the Row itself filled the cell but its digits were laid out from the top, leaving all the extra space below in a tall widget. The change wraps the Row in an Item that takes the layout cell, sizes the digits from that item's height and centres the Row vertically in it.

commits.message:
applets/timer: vertically center the digits in the desktop widget

The digits row took the full height of its layout cell but only drew its
digits at the top, so a widget taller than the digits left all its empty
space below them. Wrap the row in an item and center it vertically there.

BUG: 459475

media.caption: Master: 304x448 Timer in edit mode, digits at the top of the widget
Fixed: same widget, digits vertically centred
